import pymupdf,re
d=pymupdf.open('realplan.pdf')
for pg in (31,32):
    p=d[pg]
    w=p.get_text('words')
    letters=[t for t in w if re.fullmatch(r'[A-J]',t[4])]
    nums=[t for t in w if re.fullmatch(r'\d{2,4}',t[4])]
    print('page',pg,'letters',len(letters),'nums',len(nums))
    res=[]
    for L in letters:
        lx=(L[0]+L[2])/2; ly=L[3]
        best=None
        for N in nums:
            nx=(N[0]+N[2])/2; ny=N[1]
            dy=ny-ly; dx=abs(nx-lx)
            if 0<=dy<14 and dx<9:
                if best is None or dy<best[0]: best=(dy,N)
        if best: res.append((L[4],int(best[1][4]),round(lx,1),round(ly,1)))
    res.sort()
    from collections import Counter
    print(Counter(r[0] for r in res))
    for r in res: print(r)
" 2>/dev/null
